run_tabular_q_learning: run tabular Q-learning to find optimal LLVM compiler pass sequences for a benchmark
train_q_table: train a Q-table using online Q-learning with epsilon-greedy exploration on a CompilerGym environment
rollout_policy: rollout a trained Q-table policy greedily to evaluate the resulting compiler pass sequence
select_action_epsilon_greedy: select an action from the Q-table using epsilon-greedy strategy with random tie-breaking
make_q_table_key: create a hashable StateActionTuple key from Autophase features, action, and step index
